title: The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, August 2, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, August 2, 2nd, (AAPL) and Pfizer (PFE). 147 points.
Wednesday the Dow was down -81.37 (-0.32%) at 25,333.8.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.49%.
There were 10 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Apple (AAPL) +5.89% and Intel (INTC) +1.48%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) -3.66% and 3M (MMM) -2.48%.
Boeing (BA -0.99%) was downgraded to ‘Hold’ from ‘Buy’ at Nord/LB.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended up five-tenths of a cent at $2.874
